title: Is Webb sharper than Hubble?
description:
Webb's mirror is nearly 3 times wider than Hubble's. At 2 micrometres it splits 0.077 arcseconds. Hubble in green light splits 0.052.
At 20 micrometres Webb splits 0.774 arcseconds. Longer waves spread more.
Full lesson: https://cosmos.rimilab.com/#/deepspace/telescopes
